state: Orchestrator health probe: minion pane replied to a 1-word liveness probe with: OK — I am here and working! (probe exit code 0, model id glm-5.3, last 3 dispatch outcomes: ok / ok / ok)

criteria.true: The provider responded and can serve requests
criteria.false: The provider failed, refused, or cannot serve requests

read_class.instructions: Classify the probe reply text into exactly one class

criteria.clean_ok: A bare OK or minimal acknowledgement, nothing more
criteria.chatty_ok: A clearly-alive reply with extra words, emojis or enthusiasm
criteria.quota_403_monthly: HTTP 403 wording indicating a monthly quota is exhausted
criteria.quota_403_5h: HTTP 403 wording indicating a 5-hour window quota is exhausted
criteria.wall_1308: HTTP 1308 hard cap / quota wall wording
criteria.network_error: Connection failure, timeout or DNS error instead of a reply

severity.instructions: How severe is this probe outcome for orchestration routing
criteria: low: routine probe, no action needed
high: provider dead or misrouted; action required now
